criteria.name: CI Pipeline Configuration and Merge Blocking
criteria.description: CI pipeline enforces lint, type check, test suite execution, and security scans; merges on red strictly blocked from Week 1.

scale.3: Complete CI pipeline configured and blocking merges on lint, type, test, or scan failure.
scale.2: CI configured with required stages, minor caching optimization missing.
scale.1: CI pipeline permits merges on warning or skips type check.

criteria.name: Container Best Practices and Security
criteria.description: Pinned base image tags (zero :latest), multi-stage build, runs as non-root user, minimal file inclusion, explicit health check.

scale.3: All containers follow pinned digest/version, multi-stage, non-root USER, and HEALTHCHECK instructions.
scale.2: Containers secure with pinned tags, minor non-root permission adjustment needed.
scale.1: Runs as root or includes unnecessary source files.
scale.0: Uses :latest tag or insecure privileged execution.

criteria.name: Single-Command Seeded Preview Environment
criteria.description: A single command brings up the complete system with reproducible seed data in local preview.

scale.3: One command docker-compose up brings up app, database, and seeds baseline data cleanly.
scale.2: Preview environment functions, minor manual step in initial seed script.
scale.1: Preview setup requires multiple undocumented manual steps.

criteria.name: Verified Rollback and Backup Restore
criteria.description: Rollback and database backup restore procedures were actually executed with tool verification, not merely drafted.

scale.3: Both rollback drill and database restore executed once with logged operational evidence.
scale.2: Rollback executed, database backup script tested without full restore drill.
scale.1: Rollback steps documented in text only without verified run.

criteria.name: Secret Management and Git Hygiene
criteria.description: Config externalized via env vars; zero credentials committed; .gitignore strictly covers all secret files.

scale.3: Zero secrets in git history or container layers; environment-driven configuration verified.
scale.2: Clean hygiene, minor template placeholder in .env.example noted.
scale.1: Potential secret or test credential present in committed config.

criteria.name: Runbook Executability and Tool Fidelity
criteria.description: Every command documented in docs/runbook.md was verified against real execution in the environment.

scale.3: 100% of runbook commands verified and runnable verbatim by an operator.
scale.2: Runbook clear and functional, minor shell syntax note for zsh/bash.
scale.1: Runbook contains incomplete or pseudo-code command lines.
